newsitem.title: USA: Harte-Hanks to buy Disney unit.
newsitem.headline: Harte-Hanks to buy Disney unit.

text.p: Harte-Hanks Communications Inc said Monday it had signed a definitive agreement with ABC Inc to buy its ABC Shoppers Group in a deal worth about $104 million in cash.
The company said in a statement that the deal, which it expects to close by the end of September, will help it expand its shopper group.
It also said it expected the deal to be accretive to earnings in 1998.
"The ABC shoppers are expected to generate 1997 revenues of approximately $67 million," it said.
The group publishes free circulation advertising publications reaching an estimated 2.4 million households in California and the U.S. Midwest, it said.
ABC Inc is an indirect subsidiary of The Walt Disney Co.
Based in San Antonio, Texas, Harte-Hanks Communications owns and operates an international direct marketing company.
